author: Robin_DD_J
body:
!!Before anyone reads this, this is my thoughts so you shouldn't be hating!!

So there is a lot of things on avicus when the pvp is *messed* up. So like:

Some players take "Insane" kb and some barly even take any. Today I probably hit fazer like 6 blocks up in the air + he flew away 20 blocks, that isnt the logic in mc. It might be the players router yes.. But as I just said this happens to me aswell, so no. I would like to suggest fixing the code.

The fast hit glitch, it probably gets *a lot* of reports that staff have to take care of. And then it is just annoying, it is bassicly like a hack just that you can't help it. Once again this has probably something to do with the code.

The damage, once again the code, it takes 3 freaking hits with barb to kill a player with full leather armor ( nebula )

And I should might not complain about this though I know nothing about coding but I think the Ivy should know.

-----------------------------------

And now we got those of you spamming me, WE ONLY HAVE IVY!!!!1111!, well I know.
Avicus should focus on getting 2 or 1 more coder/coders. Ive been around for like 1 month now, and I have barly seen anything new. Getting this new coder will make the server better and more players would start playing. And then they might have time to actually fix these pvp problems though they effect the gameplay a lot.

Thanks for reading. And if you are only going to complain because you are some kinda fanboy, just don't. Thanks
